description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004 - DR-P2P-011 payment disbursement and DR-A2S-010 customer collection. One entry type with a direction, since both carry the same inputs.

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: Receive settles a customer's invoice (DR-A2S-010); Pay settles a supplier's bill (DR-P2P-011).

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: whether this settles with a customer or a supplier.

fields.label: Party
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: who paid or was paid. A real reference, so a payment cannot name a party that does not exist.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: disbursement amount / remittance amount

fields.label: Payment Mode
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: how the money moved (NEFT, RTGS, cheque, cash).

fields.label: Bank Account
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: the bank or cash account the money moved through. Debited on a receipt, credited on a payment.

fields.label: Business Status
fields.options:
Draft
Pending Bank Authorization
Disbursed / Cleared
Rejected / Bounced
Cancelled
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: CD-002 'Payment Entry' lifecycle (PROPOSED). Set only via knit360_core.business_status.engine.transition

fields.label: Allocated
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: the part of this payment matched to documents, computed.

fields.label: Unallocated (held for the party)
fields.description: FR-FIN-002 / FR-FIN-004: the part not matched to any document. It is an advance held for the party, not income, and can be applied to a later invoice. Computed.

name: KNIT 360 Payment Entry
